summary: Your 2004 BMW 3 Series has 150,000 miles and is showing its age in the electrical system and exterior lights. We need to stay on top of regular maintenance to keep it running smoothly.

known_problems.explanation: Exterior lighting includes your headlights and taillights. These help you see and be seen at night, but they can sometimes fail.
The electrical system is the network of wires and fuses that power everything in your car. Problems here can affect many different features.
Air bags are the cushions that inflate in a crash to protect you. Some drivers have reported issues with them on this car.
Visibility and wipers include your windshield wipers and defrosters. These keep your view clear when it rains or snows.

maintenance_due.why: Spark plugs create the spark that starts your engine fuel. At 150,000 miles, your current ones are well past their recommended lifespan.
A drive belt is a rubber band that turns engine accessories like your alternator. At this mileage, the rubber can crack and break.

declined_services.risk_if_ignored: Old fluid can cause your transmission to slip, struggle to shift gears, or fail completely.
Old coolant loses its ability to protect the engine from overheating, which can warp or crack the engine block.

disclaimers: Costs and difficulty are estimates, not quotes.
Brakes, airbags, and fuel lines: have a professional check your work.
